newsitem.title: MEXICO: Bufete says it wins BASF project.
newsitem.headline: Bufete says it wins BASF project.

text.p: Mexican builder Bufete Industrial won a unit-price contract for BASF Mexicana, subsidiary of Germany chemicals company BASF AG, Bufete said on Wednesday.

Bufete said the project will be the construction of a styrene copolymers (ACE) plant in Altamira, Tamaulipas. The plant is due to be finished by December 1997 and will have production capacity of 130,000 tonnes per year, Bufete said in a statement.
The company did not reveal the contract's value, but said BASF's global investment in the plant would be about $158 million.
"The copolymers to be produced, a material necessary for the automotive and electronic industries, will primarily serve the international markets," Bufete said.
Cesar Barandiaran, construction vice-president of Bufete, said the company is about to complete the engineering, procurement and construction for BASF's polystyrene plant, also in Altamira.
